easy.text: What was the song of the sirens like? It was a song that showed you everything you wanted and everything you lost. It made you think about the things you could never have again.
Your men don't want you to defy the gods. But the gods say only you make it home. Then I defy the gods and choose my own path.
The power of the sacrifice is in the cost of the person making it. A sacrifice means more when someone gives something important.
He can talk. Why didn't he talk before? Do you talk to ants? Sometimes we forget that others see the world differently.
These songs probably seem silly. They make me cry. They remind me of what was lost and everything that can never return.
Why can't gods speak in ways we understand? They speak through thunder, fire, a child's smile, and a good harvest.
Don't look for gods in men; you'll always be disappointed. People can be great, but they are still only people.
Is this a mutiny? It is up to you. The choice is yours, and you must decide what happens next.
Help me go home. After everything I have lost, returning home is the only thing I want.
Ten years on this beach. Let's go home. We have waited long enough and it is time to leave.

medium.text: All the things you wanted to be and then all the things you wished you never wished for. It was a delicious itch you want to scratch but you find it under the skin and can't reach it.
So the delicious itch becomes unbearable. It told you what you most want is what you most can't have and that the most you can't have is what you already had and lost.
Come back as a prince, call a banquet. I'll be there. Beg. The clearest view of men is from below.
The power of the sacrifice is in the cost of the person making it. A true sacrifice requires someone to give up something that truly matters.
Are there any loyal servants? Some. When Odysseus shows himself, all. They have waited for the moment when their king returns.
The lotus clouds the mind, saps the will, but doesn't change who you are. You weren't ready to go home for whatever reason.
You're not always going to be the strongest or the fastest, so be the smartest. Strength alone cannot solve every problem.
Hunting's nothing but fighting with stealth. Clever, but your cleverness is going to get you in trouble.
After years of war, no one could stand between my men and home. Not even me. We had already sacrificed so much.
Fortune favors the brave. Those who act with courage often discover opportunities that others never find.

hard.text: It was a song of all the promises I failed to keep. And it told me I don't really want to go home. It showed me the deepest regrets I carried within myself.
What if the Odysseus you knew lost his way? What if one night, in a strange city, he saw things that made him think the home he knew couldn't possibly be there anymore?
What if when he left the belly of the horse and opened the gates of Troy, he saw ten years of rage pour into that city in one night? What if he understood the destruction he had caused?
We left them a gift, an offering of peace, that they took into their home. We violated all that's ever sacred between people. It turned a fight into a hunt.
To burn the walls of Troy was to burn the world entire, including his home. What if he knew, that very night, as he walked through fires and pain, exactly what he had done?
One man's idea, one man's trick to break Zeus's law forever. We lived in a world of palaces, trades, and language, blinded by beauty, until we broke it.
My misfortune was to make it home. Be welcomed by my beautiful wife, bathed, anointed, made soft. To learn the hardest lesson that the greatest dangers can wait behind familiar doors.
Don't make my mistake. Don't walk in the front door expecting garlands and praise. Come in disguise, take your time, and assess the truth before revealing yourself.
You're a man who needs to control your fate. But you cannot control this. You must give yourself to the storm, give yourself to Poseidon, and accept your punishment.
Give up the fight, give up control and live. It is a leap of faith you haven't yet made, but one you must eventually take if you wish to survive.
